heading: What Open Brain is
content: Open Brain is pitched as 'the infrastructure layer for your thinking' -- one Supabase database + pgvector, one MCP protocol, any AI client, no SaaS middleware chains. Explicitly not a notes app: 'a database with vector search and an open protocol' so every AI tool (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code, whatever ships next) shares one persistent memory. Created by Nate B. Jones, with Matt Hallett as first community admin. This repo is the community layer on top of a core Open Brain setup -- extensions/recipes/schemas/dashboards/integrations/skills that plug into one canonical thoughts table. FSL-1.1-MIT licensed (source-available, no-commercial-derivative-works, converts to MIT after a time delay). CONTRIBUTING.md is the actual constitution: defines what goes in each folder, required files (README.md + metadata.json), a metadata JSON-schema, an automated PR-review bot, and a non-technical contribution path where mentors turn plain-language ideas into PRs for non-coders.

heading: Repository structure by category
content: extensions/ (curated, ordered, 6 builds forming 'the learning path': household-knowledge, home-maintenance, family-calendar, meal-planning, professional-crm, job-hunt -- each with README.md, metadata.json, schema.sql, index.ts Deno/Supabase Edge Function MCP server, deno.json, .env.example; extensions/_template/AGENT_SPEC.md is a machine-readable generator spec). primitives/ (curated README-only concept guides referenced by 2+ extensions: rls, shared-mcp, remote-mcp, deploy-edge-function, troubleshooting). recipes/ (open, ~30 folders: data importers for chatgpt/perplexity/obsidian-vault/x-twitter/instagram/google-activity/grok-export/journals-blogger/email-history, plus workflow tooling like auto-capture, panning-for-gold, claudeception, schema-aware-routing, daily-digest, life-engine, live-retrieval, content-fingerprint-dedup, local-ollama-embeddings, ob-graph, repo-learning-coach, research-to-decision-workflow, vercel-neon-telegram, work-operating-model-activation, source-filtering, infographic-generator). schemas/ (open, sparse -- only schemas/workflow-status/migration.sql is real). dashboards/ (open-brain-dashboard SvelteKit and open-brain-dashboard-next Next.js, both Vercel/Netlify frontend templates). integrations/ (slack-capture, discord-capture, kubernetes-deployment self-hosted). skills/ (open plain-text SKILL.md/*.skill.md packs: auto-capture, claudeception, panning-for-gold, competitive-analysis, financial-model-review, deal-memo-drafting, research-synthesis, meeting-synthesis, heavy-file-ingestion, work-operating-model, autodream-brain-sync, n-agentic-harnesses, weekly-signal-diff). docs/ (01-getting-started.md 45-min setup walkthrough, 02-companion-prompts.md, 03-faq.md, 04-ai-assisted-setup.md, 05-tool-audit.md). resources/ (official packaged skill bundles). server/index.ts is the canonical core MCP server distributed from repo root.

heading: The core thoughts table / memory schema
content: Base schema: create table thoughts (id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key, content text not null, embedding vector(1536), metadata jsonb default '{}'::jsonb, created_at timestamptz default now(), updated_at timestamptz default now()). Indexes: HNSW on embedding (vector_cosine_ops) for ANN similarity search, GIN on metadata for filtering, btree on created_at desc. RLS is enabled with a service_role-only policy. A later migration adds content_fingerprint TEXT (SHA-256 hash, unique partial index) plus an upsert_thought() RPC for idempotent dedup-on-write. metadata jsonb carries all classification: type (observation|task|idea|reference|person_note), topics[], people[], action_items[], dates_mentioned[], source. Hard guard rail: never alter or drop existing thoughts columns or modify the core MCP server -- additive changes only. schemas/workflow-status/migration.sql shows the sanctioned extension pattern: adds status and status_updated_at columns, never touches existing ones.

heading: MCP usage -- remote-only hard rule
content: MCP servers must be deployed as remote Supabase Edge Functions (Deno + Hono + @modelcontextprotocol/sdk + StreamableHTTPTransport) -- never StdioServerTransport or local Node servers, never wired via claude_desktop_config.json. Connection happens through each client's custom-connector UI (URL + key). The canonical implementation is server/index.ts: a Hono app wrapping an McpServer with 4 tools (search_thoughts, list_thoughts, thought_stats, capture_thought), auth via x-brain-key header or ?key= query param checked against MCP_ACCESS_KEY, CORS preflight handling, and a documented workaround for Claude Desktop connectors not sending the right Accept header. Every extension replicates this exact skeleton per extensions/_template/AGENT_SPEC.md. primitives/remote-mcp/README.md documents per-client connection recipes (Claude Desktop, ChatGPT Developer Mode, claude mcp add --transport http, Cursor native url field, supergateway/mcp-remote bridges for stdio-only clients) and warns mcp-remote triggers OAuth discovery that breaks against Supabase's simple key auth -- use supergateway --streamableHttp instead. docs/05-tool-audit.md discusses MCP context economics directly relevant to a websocket/frontend layer aggregating many tools: 150-400 tokens per tool definition, tool-search deferred-loading, routing misfires past roughly 10 tools.

heading: Embeddings / pgvector / RAG retrieval flow
content: Write path (capture_thought in server/index.ts): text goes to parallel OpenRouter calls for (a) text-embedding-3-small embedding (1536-dim) and (b) gpt-4o-mini JSON-mode metadata extraction, then upsert_thought() RPC does SHA-256 fingerprint dedup and merges metadata into existing row on conflict, then the embedding column is updated in a second write. Read path (search_thoughts): query text goes to an OpenRouter embedding call, then match_thoughts(query_embedding, match_threshold, match_count, filter jsonb) RPC computes 1 - (embedding <=> query_embedding) cosine similarity ordered/limited, with optional jsonb @> metadata filter, default threshold 0.7 (server default 0.5). list_thoughts/thought_stats do plain Postgres filtering over metadata (no embedding) for recency/keyword browsing. Dedup is its own reusable pattern in recipes/content-fingerprint-dedup/README.md (normalize, SHA-256, ON CONFLICT upsert; battle-tested to 75,000+ thoughts across 9 import sources). recipes/local-ollama-embeddings offers a local-model alternative to OpenRouter embeddings. recipes/live-retrieval/README.md closes the retrieval loop proactively -- a Claude Code skill that fires search_thoughts/list_thoughts on topic-shift detection during active work sessions, logging hit/miss to .claude/live-retrieval-log.jsonl.

heading: Taxonomy: extensions vs primitives vs recipes vs skills
content: From CONTRIBUTING.md's 'What Goes Where' table: extensions are curated, ordered, full progressive builds (schema + MCP server + guide) that compound into an interconnected personal-agent system and require maintainer sign-off. Primitives are curated concept documentation only, extracted once 2+ extensions need the same pattern (RLS, shared MCP). Recipes are open, standalone, no-ordering capability builds -- fuller builds like setup guides, schema changes, automation wiring, end-to-end implementations, and can declare requires_skills. Skills are open, smaller, plain-text portable prompt/behavior packs meant to be the canonical reusable unit recipes depend on rather than re-embedding. This taxonomy maps directly onto a 'skill / memory / project reference' content model: skills/ approximates the reusable behavior/prompt layer, the thoughts table plus recipes/schemas approximates the memory/data layer, and extensions/primitives approximates the curated project-reference/pattern layer.

heading: Dashboards / frontend precedent for a websocket/UI layer
content: dashboards/README.md plus two implementations, both explicitly meant to host on Vercel or Netlify pointed at a Supabase backend: open-brain-dashboard (SvelteKit, MCP proxy + Supabase email/password auth, capture form, search/filter by type/topic/people, stats) and open-brain-dashboard-next (Next.js 16/React 19/Tailwind 4) which talks to a separate REST gateway (open-brain-rest Edge Function, not the MCP server directly) via endpoints like /search, /capture, /stats, /duplicates, uses iron-session encrypted cookies for API-key auth, and includes a drag-and-drop Kanban 'Workflow' board (@dnd-kit) built on the schemas/workflow-status migration, semantic-duplicate resolution UI, and a 'smart ingest' auto-router (short text becomes a single capture, long text becomes extraction with dry-run preview). This is a concrete precedent for a websocket/frontend layer sitting over a memory backend.
